subject: MedCloud security questionnaire launch — clarifying data-scope & evidence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Jake Martinez <jake@medcloud.health>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedCloud security questionnaire launch — clarifying data-scope & evidence

Hi Jake / Anna —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can route the right artifacts to your team and avoid back-and-forth during the SIG/CAIQ prefill:

1) Scope: You confirmed the initial scope is Redwood-hosted inference for patient triage workflows (EU and US users) — please confirm whether any contract data will be stored persistently in your environment or sent to Redwood for logging. That determines whether we need HIPAA-covered evidence beyond our SOC 2 report.

2) SOC 2: We’re SOC 2 Type II (Security + Availability) for the last 12 months. I attached a short SOC 2 summary (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf) — let us know if you need the full report and an NDA.

3) Data residency & encryption: We encrypt at-rest and in-transit. For KMS, we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/HSM in Private deployments — are you expecting CMK usage for this engagement or is Redwoods’ managed keys acceptable for the hosted pilot?

4) Questionnaire format: You mentioned SIG with some CAIQ fields. To speed things up we prepared a prefill (MedCloud_SIG_v1.xlsx) that covers the typical SIG sections we can complete internally. Can you confirm which of these sections you want completed by the vendor versus the customer: Access Control, Change Management, Data Lifecycle, Logging/Audit?

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the data residency/KMS expectations (reply with a line or two).
- Jake/Anna mark the SIG sections to prefill and we’ll return an editable XLSX within 48 hours.
- If the full SOC 2 report is required, I’ll loop in Legal for an NDA.

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if that helps.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MedCloud_SIG_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 67KB); SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Jake Martinez <jake@medcloud.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Liao <anna.liao@medcloud.health>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedCloud security questionnaire launch — clarifying data-scope & evidence

Thanks Hannah — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: For the trial we only need US-resident processing. If the pilot goes to production we will require EU-region processing for EU patients.

- PHI/HIPAA: The triage payload will include PHI. We will need evidence of HIPAA controls (BAA + control mappings). If you’re SOC 2-only, please flag which control families map to HIPAA requirements.

- KMS: Production will require customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) in our account. Hosted pilot can use Redwood-managed keys, but please document the process to transition to our CMK.

- SIG sections: Please prefill everything from Authentication, Access Control, Logging, and Data Retention. We’ll fill any environment-specific answers on our side.

Can you also include a short statement on your logging/retention windows for request traces (how long KV cache and request logs are retained for hosted API calls)?

If you can send the updated prefill and a mapping of SOC2->HIPAA controls, we’ll review and get the procurement/security teams involved.

Best,
Jake Martinez
Head of Security Operations, MedCloud Health
jake@medcloud.health | +1 (617) 555-0124

Thanks — and noted. Quick answers inline: 
- EU region: we support EU-hosted inference in our Frankfurt and Dublin regions; we’ll note the production region requirement in the prefill.
- HIPAA: Redwood has a BAA template we can share. I’ll ask Legal to prepare it; separately I’ll attach a short SOC2->HIPAA control mapping doc in the prefill package (high level).
- KMS: We support a staged migration: hosted pilot on Redwood-managed keys; when you’re ready for product we provide a runbook for creating a cross-account CMK and rotating to your key with no downtime. I’ll include the runbook excerpt.
- Logging/retention: For hosted API calls we keep request traces and audit logs for 90 days by default; KV cache is ephemeral per-session (max 24 hours unless customer elects caching for a private deployment). We’ll include this as a short statement in the prefill.

Plan: Aditya will turn the XLSX into a prefilled SIG with the SOC2->HIPAA mapping and the CMK runbook excerpt and send back within 48 hours. Lauren — I’ve added you to track the BAA path.

Hannah
